name: RPS Duel
storyline:
In a world where every choice counts, warriors clash in the ultimate test of instinct and strategy — Rock, Paper, Scissors.
Each duel is a battle of wits, reflexes, and psychology.
Rise through the ranks, challenge opponents from around the globe, and claim your place at the top of the leaderboard.
Simple rules, infinite possibilities — one move can change everything.
summary: RPS Duel is a fast-paced online multiplayer game that brings a competitive twist to the classic Rock-Paper-Scissors. Challenge players from around the world in real-time duels with instant matchmaking and ELO-based rankings. Track your progress on the global leaderboard and climb the ranks to become the ultimate RPS champion. No ads, no distractions — just pure skill and strategy.
